page.overview:
Who is Cyrus Wyvernwind?

was Dorian Storm's brother. As an NPC, was played by Matthew Mercer in Critical Role and by Aabria Iyengar in Exandria Unlimited.

Cyrus had blue skin, light green eyes, wavy shoulder-length black hair, and a square jaw. He wore a gold septum piercing and was burlier and taller than his younger brother. He had consistently worn a light grey cloak, a heavy hood, full-body studded leather armor, and gauntlets. He was 6 foot 3 inches tall.

Cyrus was good-natured, but somewhat naive, a man who easily got into trouble. He was also proud, and liked people guessing how important his family was.

Cyrus was born before 816 PD as the eldest son of the rulers of the Silken Squall, and was followed by a younger brother, Brontë, born in 816 PD. They frequently would get into physical fights, hitting each other until they returned to their parents bleeding and crying; that, however, didn't stop them from doing the same again, since it was one of the ways the two of them bonded.
